{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for 'SEVERE' in severity column
print("Unique severity values:", df['severity'].unique())

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline and count
print("Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check if there are patients with SEVERE disease
severe_patients = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']
print("Number of patients with SEVERE disease:", len(severe_patients))

# Confirm the data types and sample of biomarker_baseline
print("First few biomarker_baseline values:", df['biomarker_baseline'].head())"}
